n = int(input())
b = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))

totalCount = 0
totalSum = 0
oddCount = 0
evenCount = 0
diffList = []

for i in range(n):
    if arr[i] % 2 != 0:
        oddCount += 1
    else:
        evenCount += 1
    if i != n - 1 and oddCount == evenCount:
        diffList.append(abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]))

diffList.sort()

for diff in diffList:
    totalSum += diff
    if totalSum <= b:
        totalCount += 1
    else:
        break

print(totalCount)
</translated_code>
